test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Consequence
solution: The correct answer is: **Outcome** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Consequence **means the result or effect of an action. (किसी क्रिया का परिणाम या प्रभाव) • **For example**: *The consequence of his actions was a loss of trust among his friends.* • **Outcome **means the result of an activity or process. (किसी गतिविधि या प्रक्रिया का परिणाम) • **For example**: *The hard work and preparation resulted in a positive outcome for the team.* • Both words have similar meanings and can be used interchangeably in most cases. Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Origin **means the point or place where something begins, arises, or is derived. (वह बिंदु या स्थान जहां कोई चीज़ शुरू होती है, उत्पन्न होती है या उत्पन्न होती है) • **Start **means the beginning of something. (किसी चीज़ की शुरुआत) • **Begin **means to start doing something. (कुछ करना शुरू करना) 1ae:T94f, The correct answer is: **Aisle**
